title: Financial wellbeing check
intro: Eight questions about how you feel about your financial situation right now. This is not a validated clinical instrument. Your answers are not stored and are never shared with your employer.

instrument.name: NestSelf Financial Wellbeing Check (not a validated clinical instrument)
instrument.licence: NestSelf-authored instrument. The source URL is background reading on financial stress and employee wellbeing from WHO, not a licence reference.

questions.text: I worry about having enough money to cover my monthly expenses
I feel stressed when I think about my financial situation
I avoid looking at my bank statements or bills
I find it difficult to save any money each month
I feel uncertain about how to plan for my financial future
Money concerns affect my sleep or concentration
I feel I lack the knowledge to make confident financial decisions
I would feel unable to handle an unexpected expense

bands.title: Low financial stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a low level of financial stress. Keeping good financial habits will help you stay on track.
bands.nextStep: Explore our budget worksheet and financial wellbeing articles for practical tips.

bands.title: Moderate financial stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a moderate level of financial stress. A conversation with a financial adviser could help you feel more in control.
bands.nextStep: Consider booking a confidential session with a financial adviser through your employer's programme.

bands.title: High financial stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a high level of financial stress. Professional financial guidance is available and can help you find practical next steps.
bands.nextStep: We recommend booking a confidential session with a financial adviser through your employer's programme. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

bands.title: Very high financial stress
bands.body: Your responses suggest a very high level of financial stress. Please consider reaching out for support soon.
bands.nextStep: Book a confidential session with a financial adviser through your employer's programme as soon as possible. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

disclaimer: This tool is not a medical device and does not provide a diagnosis. It is for informational purposes only. For a clinical evaluation, talk to a licensed professional. If you are in crisis, call the emergency number.

crisis.title: Need immediate help?
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.
